top_signals.title: US Bonds Fall as Treasury Is Silent on Long End, Oil Climbs
top_signals.summary: Treasuries declined as predictions fell flat that US government officials would directly nod at the possibility of reducing its sales of long-term debt and as oil prices rose.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: U.S. budget deficit swells to almost $2 trillion for fiscal 2026, up 12% in a single year
top_signals.summary: The Treasury Department published the U.S. budget deficit for the 2026 fiscal year.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
